newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Aircraft unit gets $70 mln Boeing contract.
newsitem.headline: Israel Aircraft unit gets $70 mln Boeing contract.

text.p: Elta Electronics Industries, a subsidiary of state-owned Israel Aircraft Industries Ltd, said on Tuesday it has concluded a contract worth about $70 million with Boeing Defence & Space Group.

The contract is for the supply of Electronic Support Measure (ESM) Systems for the British Royal Air Force's Nimrod 2000 programme. The prime contractor for the Nimrod 2000 is British Aerospace and Boeing is a subcontractor.

Elta will supply prototypes and operational systems for the Nimrod 2000 aircraft fleet. The first prototype will be supplied in 1999 and the project's duration is about eight years. This is Elta's first contract for the British Royal Air Force.
